question: The Constituent Assembly of India was set up in which year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1946**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Cabinet Mission Plan** of **1946 **first proposed the **constituent assembly.**
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0538d3f221bb7fe75ebed7e7950d59df3aa38203f406d3eb35c3b6cd3ce432c5.png] 
 
• Members of the **Constituent Assembly** were elected by the Provincial Legislative Assemblies.
